Basic Scope/Fork/Join is source C. Match source child evidence at scope call, sibling forks, unstarted cancellation, nested scopes/tasks, pool exhaustion, managed captures and fixed-pool reuse.

Seven existing ledger replacements and the exact 70000-length observation are separate decisions. Full std corpus/trait derivations and suspend/task/cancel owners must be matched rather than inferred from synchronous views.

Match mixed scalar bits, Borrowed/Owned/StringBuffer native results/held args, aggregate fields, task success/context release/cancel and NULL outputs. Probe adapters must be supplied explicitly; rejection without them is not a missing source feature.
Match exact immediate/delayed ordering, duplicate resume defect identity, operation tail and queued-event disposal. Existing suspend tests are candidates; source acceptance alone is insufficient.

Compare the complete mixed source fixture, including nested generic error show, custom/derived traits, constructor-pattern lambdas, collection ownership, failures and any concurrent pieces. Synchronous extraction is not completion of the full source.
Readonly prefix is reviewed separately. Match heapless comparisons/ISR/tail stack behavior, owned subviews without allocation, returned List[String] lifetime and suspend/cancel capture disposal.

Root services checkpoint covers independent Board symbols/Clock/Console/owned receive lists. Preserve required header artifacts, module registration/nonshadowing and timer notification/cancel/reuse observations. Frontend-only old tests do not require fabricated runtime evidence.
